notes.text:
constraints (2026-09-12): 165 bpm 4/4, 32 bars, seamless loop. Intro 4 / A 8 / A' 8 / B 8 / turnaround 4.
triangle: gallop (1 & a) on chord roots the whole way, no melody, bass moves at most once per bar — skeleton has it all on E, pick the roots.
pulse1: A = one 2-bar motif stated 4x, same rhythm, different pitches; B is the only place the lead runs.
pulse2: A = arpeggiated chord tones in 16ths; B = harmonize the lead a 3rd or 6th below.
pulse1/pulse2 each hold ONE placeholder note at 1.1 so the tracks survive the file — erase them.
drums: kick 1 & 3, snare 2 & 4, hats every 8th (in place); ONE fill, turnaround only (not written).
harmony: A stays home; B must go somewhere A didn't. No chord shorter than a bar, none longer than two.
